missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Офицер' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'вошёл'. 'Молодой' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'в кабинет' is the accusative direction.

Strategic focus: Accusative of an animate masculine noun. 'Офицера' is the accusative direct object of 'уважают'; for animate nouns it takes the genitive ending. 'Своего' agrees in the animate accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Офицера' is the genitive form showing whose order it is. 'Нашего' agrees in the masculine genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Офицеру' is the dative form required by 'подчиняться', marking the one obeyed. 'Старшему' agrees in the masculine dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with 'с'. 'Офицером' is the instrumental form after 'с', expressing with whom one spoke. 'Дежурным' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Об офицере' uses the prepositional form after 'о' to express the topic. 'Храбром' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Офицеры' is the nominative plural subject of 'стояли'. 'Русские' agrees in the plural, and 'на параде' is the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural of animate nouns. 'Офицеров' is the accusative plural equal to the genitive plural for animate nouns. 'Отличившихся' agrees in the animate accusative plural.
Strategic focus: Dative plural recipient. 'Офицерам' is the dative plural marking those to whom awards were given. 'Молодым' agrees in the dative plural, and 'награды' is the accusative object.

missions.phrase: В штабе нет ни одного офицера.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Офицера' is the genitive form required after the negation 'нет'. 'Ни одного' reinforces the absence in the masculine genitive.
